pages.brief: Pip curled up in the ivy nest at night, one wing over his head, tiny and cosy. Deep blues, one small warm spot of colour on him.
pages.alt: Pip is curled up in his ivy nest at night, one wing over his head, tiny and cosy against the deep blue dark.

pages.brief: The same nest from outside, tiny in a huge dark garden, with the night suddenly loud — show it as every leaf and branch drawn sharp and startled. No visible source yet.
pages.alt: The same nest is seen from outside, tiny in a huge dark garden, the oak looming sharp and startled above it as the night suddenly turns loud.

pages.brief: Extreme close-up of Pip's face, eyes enormous, feathers on end, gripping the nest edge. The whole page is his fright.
pages.alt: An extreme close-up of Pip's face, his eyes enormous and feathers on end, gripping the edge of the nest. The whole page is his fright.

pages.brief: Pip climbing cautiously out over the rim of the nest into the dark, one foot testing the branch. Brave and very small.
pages.alt: Pip climbs cautiously out over the rim of the nest into the dark, one foot testing the branch, brave and very small.

pages.brief: Reveal page: Olive the owl on a branch above, lit by the moon, entirely unbothered, mid-hoot. Draw her big and round and slightly ridiculous.
pages.alt: Reveal page: Olive the owl sits on a branch above, lit by the moon, entirely unbothered and mid-hoot, big and round and slightly ridiculous.

pages.brief: Olive's hoot from Pip's viewpoint — Olive close and enormous, beak wide, Pip a tiny silhouette in the corner of the frame.
pages.alt: Olive's hoot fills the page from Pip's viewpoint — close and enormous, beak wide — while Pip is a tiny silhouette in the corner of the frame.

pages.brief: Pip and Olive face to face on the branch, Pip's relief written all over him, Olive faintly apologetic. Warm despite the night palette.
pages.alt: Pip and Olive stand face to face on the branch, Pip's relief written all over him and Olive looking faintly apologetic.

pages.brief: Pip flying back to the nest with his shoulders down, calm now. The garden drawn friendly again — soft edges instead of sharp ones.
pages.alt: Pip flies back to the nest with his shoulders down, calm now, the garden drawn soft and friendly again.

pages.brief: Pip tucked back in, eyes shut, one wing over his head exactly as on page one. Same composition as page one so children spot the echo.
pages.alt: Pip is tucked back in, eyes shut, one wing over his head exactly as before — the garden quiet and still around him.

pages.brief: Closing page: wide still garden at night, the oak, the nest, the moon, Olive a small shape on her branch keeping watch. Deeply peaceful.
pages.alt: A wide, still garden at night: the oak, the nest, the moon, and Olive keeping watch as a small shape on her branch. Deeply peaceful.
